Sargeras Embrace
30 Energy, plus 30 per sec
Channeled1 min cooldown
Channel a beam of fel magic upon an enemy, slowing your target's movement speed by 60% for 5.5 sec and dealing COND(GT(FireP, ShaP), 695+0+FireP*0.85, 695+0+ShaP*0.85) Shadowflame Damage at the end of the duration.

For the duration, you may instant cast Fel Fireball and Ruin while channeling and they refund their cost.
